Instead of having a strictly controlled media narrative glorifying the war and the soldiers, people actually got to see what was happening with their own eyes - and they didn't like it.

Society, and our world, are changing so far that's it's really tough to predict where things are going other than in a very different direction than have since pretty much the beginning of modern civilization if not mankind itself.
